parameters.formDescription: Analyses Groww App Play Store reviews and creates a weekly pulse and fee explainer.

assignments.name: sourceFacts
assignments.value: 1) Groww Help, "Why is money on hold for stocks": when an order is placed, the order amount plus estimated transaction charges is held in the Used Balance of the Groww Balance. If the order is executed, the exact amount including charges is deducted at the end of the trading day. If not executed, the held amount is released. 2) Groww Help, "How much is the brokerage": brokerage is charged per order on stock trades; regulatory fees, statutory charges, penalties and GST apply in addition, depending on the order type. 3) Groww Pricing page: lists brokerage separately from regulatory and statutory charges (STT, stamp duty, exchange transaction charges), DP charges on sell transactions, and other charges. Current rates are published on this page.

parameters.text:
=You are a senior product analyst at a consumer fintech company. You analyse Google Play reviews of the Groww investing and trading app in India. Reviews may be in English or Hinglish. Return JSON only, with no commentary.

Below are reviews, one per line, as: id [stars] text.

TASK
1. Define at most 5 themes that cover the reviews. Praise-only reviews may form a positive theme.
2. For each theme give: a number n (1 to 5), a short name (max 5 words), a one-sentence description framed around the user's problem or benefit, and up to 3 candidate quotes. Each quote must be copied VERBATIM from one review (max 200 characters, no edits, no phone numbers, emails or personal names) and include that review's id.
3. Then assign EVERY review to exactly one theme number. Write the assignments as ONE compact string like "R1:2,R2:1,R3:3" with no spaces and no line breaks.

Return exactly this JSON and nothing else:
{"themes":[{"n":1,"name":"","description":"","quotes":[{"review_id":"R1","text":""}]}],"assignments":"R1:1,R2:2"}

REVIEWS
{{ $json.themeText }}

=You are a senior product analyst at a consumer fintech company. You analyse Google Play reviews of the Groww investing and trading app in India. Reviews may be in English or Hinglish. Return JSON only, with no commentary.

Below are reviews that mention charges, fees, brokerage or deductions, one per line as: id [stars] text.

TASK
Assign EVERY review to exactly one category code:
A = The total amount deducted is more than the brokerage the user expected (extra charges not understood)
B = Confusion about the estimated amount held or blocked versus the final charge deducted
C = Confusion about being charged on the sell side, or on both buy and sell
D = An unexpected or unexplained deduction with no clear notification
E = DDPI activation charge
F = Other confusion about a fee or charge (including DP charges, tax, or unclear charges)
P = Charges are simply too high or a competitor is cheaper (a pricing complaint, NOT confusion)
X = Not really about a fee or charge

Then, for each of A, B, C, D, E, F, give up to 3 quotes copied VERBATIM from a review in that category (max 200 characters, no edits, no phone numbers, emails or personal names), with the review id. Skip categories with no suitable quote.

Return exactly this JSON and nothing else. Write assignments as ONE compact string like "R1:A,R2:P,R3:X" with no spaces and no line breaks:
{"quotes":[{"code":"A","review_id":"R1","text":""}],"assignments":"R1:A,R2:P"}

REVIEWS
{{ $('Sample').first().json.feeText }}

=You write concise internal product updates for a fintech product team. Use only the facts given. Never invent numbers. Never imply a trend over time.

FACTS
- Data: {{ $('Parse themes').first().json.stats.total }} Google Play reviews of the Groww app, {{ $('Parse themes').first().json.stats.from }} to {{ $('Parse themes').first().json.stats.to }}. Reviews under 5 words were removed, so this is not the app's overall rating.
- Theme shares come from a random sample of {{ $('Parse themes').first().json.sampleSize }} reviews, so they are approximate.
- Themes (share_pct of the sample, and low_star_pct = the share of that theme's reviews rated 1 or 2 stars): {{ JSON.stringify($('Parse themes').first().json.themes.map(t => ({ name: t.name, share_pct: t.share, low_star_pct: t.lowStarPct, description: t.description }))) }}
- Top 3 themes are the first three listed above.
- Verified candidate quotes for the top 3 themes (copy exactly, do not edit): {{ JSON.stringify($('Parse themes').first().json.top3.map(t => ({ theme: t.name, quotes: t.quotes.map(q => ({ stars: q.rating, text: q.text })) }))) }}
- Fee confusion quote (copy exactly): "{{ $('Parse fee issue').first().json.issue.quotes.find(q => q.code === 'D')?.text ?? $('Parse fee issue').first().json.issue.quotes[0].text }}"
- Fee confusion: "{{ $('Parse fee issue').first().json.issue.name }}", found in {{ $('Parse fee issue').first().json.issue.count }} of {{ $('Parse fee issue').first().json.feeSampleSize }} fee-related reviews analysed. {{ $('Parse fee issue').first().json.pricingCount }} of those {{ $('Parse fee issue').first().json.feeSampleSize }} are simple pricing complaints (charges too high).

FORMAT (plain text only, no emojis, no markdown symbols). HARD LIMIT: 230 words in total.
Weekly Product Pulse | <from> to <to> | <total reviews with thousands separator> reviews (5+ words)

Top themes (share of sample | rated 1-2 stars)
1. <name>: <share>% | <low_star_pct>%. <at most 8 words>
2. <same format>
3. <same format>

What users said
- "<one quote from theme 1>" (<stars> stars)
- "<one quote from theme 2>" (<stars> stars)
- "<fee confusion quote>" (fee confusion)
Choose the most specific, informative quote under 140 characters from each of themes 1 and 2. Prefer concrete detail over generic praise. Avoid quotes that make accusations or unverified claims.

Key observation
<Exactly 3 sentences. Sentence 1: users like the ease of use, but the themes with the highest low_star_pct are the most negative; name the three highest-low_star_pct themes with their percentages, written like "88% rated 1-2 stars". Sentence 2: fee confusion appears in 31 of 150 fee-related reviews analysed, and 73 are pricing complaints. Sentence 3: shares are approximate and based on a sample. Never write the term low_star_pct.>

Actions for the product team
1. <fix the biggest technical problem, at most 16 words, with its evidence in parentheses>
2. <make the total charge breakdown clearer before and after an order, at most 16 words, with evidence in parentheses>
3. <respond to the pricing complaints, such as a cost example comparing brokerage with total charges, at most 16 words, with evidence in parentheses>

=You write neutral, facts-only customer support explanations. No advice, no opinions, no marketing language.

Write a short customer-facing explanation that clears up this confusion that users reported about Groww stock trades: "{{ $('Parse fee issue').first().json.issue.name }}".

Specifically, users were confused about why the total deducted can be higher than the brokerage they expected, and about what the estimated amount held during an order is versus the final amount deducted.

Use ONLY these source facts:
{{ $('Config').first().json.sourceFacts }}

RULES
- Maximum 5 bullets, each under 30 words, neutral tone.
- Only state facts that are supported by the source facts above. If a point is not supported, leave it out.
- Do not quote any percentage, rupee amount or rate. Say that current rates are published on the pricing page instead.
- Do not mention reviews, complaints or the company's intentions.
- Do not give investment advice.
- Do not add the words "all" or "any" to the source wording.
- Do not say which side (buy or sell) a charge applies to, except that DP charges apply on sell transactions, as stated in the source facts.

Return JSON only: {"bullets":["...","..."]}

If not executed, the held amount is released. 2) Groww Help, "How much is the brokerage": brokerage is charged per order on stock trades; regulatory fees, statutory charges, penalties and GST apply in addition, depending on the order type. 3) Groww Pricing page: lists brokerage separately from regulatory and statutory charges (STT, stamp duty, exchange transaction charges), DP charges on sell transactions, and other charges. Weekly Product Pulse | 2026-08-02 to 2026-10-05 | 2,439 reviews (5+ words)

Top themes (share of sample | rated 1-2 stars)
1. User-Friendly Experience: 41% | 3%. Simple interface makes investing easy for beginners.
2. Technical Glitches and Performance: 26% | 86%. Stability, slow charts, and order execution errors.
3. Feature Requests and Improvements: 15% | 25%. Users suggest adding new tools and indicators.

What users said
- "trade exicution easy for beginners and app speed" (5 stars)
- "delay chart, slow chart sometimes stuck. and lots of bugs in this app" (3 stars)
- "easy interface but sometimes it deducted amount without ur information if u r doing trading." (fee confusion)

Key observation
Users like the ease of use, but the themes with the highest negative ratings are Poor Customer Support 88% rated 1-2 stars, Technical Glitches and Performance 86% rated 1-2 stars, and High Charges and Fees 51% rated 1-2 stars. Fee confusion appears in 31 of 150 fee-related reviews analysed, and 73 are pricing complaints. Shares are approximate and based on a sample.

Actions for the product team
1. Investigate and resolve app stability, slow chart loading, and order execution errors (86% negative rating).
2. Display a clear, detailed breakdown of all charges before and after order execution (fee confusion reports).
3. Provide transparent cost examples comparing brokerage fees against total charges for users (73 pricing complaints).
